updates.originalValue: docs/roadmap.mdのRESULTCURVE1を参照。GUI/API/MCPで同じ版付き物理段階、反力、標点ひずみを取得し、荷重–変位/工学SSを静止描画・CSV/JSON/画像出力。最大von Mises/変位をSSと呼ばず、独立結果を塑性履歴へつながない。
updates.proposedValue: docs/roadmap.mdのRESULTCURVE1を参照。GUI/API/MCPで同じ版付き物理段階、反力、標点ひずみを取得し、荷重–変位/工学SSを静止描画・CSV/JSON/画像出力。最大von Mises/変位をSSと呼ばず、独立結果を塑性履歴へつながない。 2026-10-23 未merge候補PR180〜185で、明示荷重列からの再入力bundle生成、独立線形solveの明示変位制御、支持/actuator反力と標点曲線、各step独立再計算、CLI/正式stdio MCP/型/容量回帰を追加。0/25/100/50/0/-50 Nの合成棒参照と反力釣合いを確認。独立線形stepであり塑性載荷履歴ではない。実Chrome保存全bytes・390px・拡大・公開HTTPSと自動段階取得/状態履歴材料接続は継続。公開済みではなく、親受入は未達。以前の「変位制御は継続」は履歴であり、明示独立線形経路の追加後の現状と区別する。

updates.originalValue: See RESULTCURVE1 in docs/en/roadmap.md. Retrieve the same revisioned physical increments, reactions and gauge strain through GUI/API/MCP; plot static force-displacement/engineering stress-strain curves and export CSV/JSON/images. updates.proposedValue: See RESULTCURVE1 in docs/en/roadmap.md. Retrieve the same revisioned physical increments, reactions and gauge strain through GUI/API/MCP; plot static force-displacement/engineering stress-strain curves and export CSV/JSON/images. Do not call maximum von Mises/displacement a stress-strain curve or concatenate independent results into a plastic history. 2026-10-23: Unmerged candidates PR180–185 add re-input bundles from explicit loads, explicit displacement-controlled independent linear solves, support/actuator reaction and gauge curves, per-step independent replay, CLI/formal stdio MCP/type/capacity regressions. The synthetic bar verifies 0/25/100/50/0/-50 N and reaction balance. Independent linear steps are not a plastic load history. Actual Chrome complete download bytes,390px,expanded output,published HTTPS,automatic increment capture and state-history material integration remain. This is not published and parent acceptance remains incomplete. Earlier displacement-control-pending wording is historical and is superseded only for the explicit independent linear path.
